conceptual assets.reasoning: The RTL declares byte-array memories mem_ram_b0..mem_ram_b3 and a synchronous read register rdata. The mem_access process writes those arrays on rising_edge(clk_i) when (bus_req_i.stb = '1') and (bus_req_i.rw = '1') with per-byte enables (e.g. mem_ram_b0(to_integer(addr)) <= bus_req_i.data(7 downto 0)); the same process loads rdata from those arrays (rdata(7 downto 0) <= mem_ram_b0(to_integer(addr)) etc.). bus_rsp_o.data is driven from rdata when rden = '1'. Corruption of the stored bytes or the read register would produce incorrect readback, so Integrity of the stored DMEM contents is Established. The memory arrays and rdata are the internal storage points implementing this concept.

conceptual assets.concept: Address selecting the accessed memory location
conceptual assets.reasoning: The concurrent assignment addr <= unsigned(bus_req_i.addr(addr_hi_c downto 2)) produces the internal address signal that indexes the memories (mem_ram_b*(to_integer(addr)) appears in both write and read assignments in mem_access). An incorrect addr value would cause reads/writes to the wrong memory location, so Integrity of the selected address is Established.

conceptual assets.concept: Read-response enable decision (when read data is presented)
conceptual assets.reasoning: The bus_feedback process registers rden <= bus_req_i.stb and (not bus_req_i.rw) on rising_edge(clk_i); the concurrent assignment bus_rsp_o.data <= rdata when (rden = '1') else (others => '0') uses rden to gate returned data. rden therefore implements the module's decision to present read data; incorrect rden would cause incorrect or suppressed responses, establishing Integrity for this decision.
